notes:
New pool sub-view **World** of the Use Cases tab (CHR-1146), between Personas and Data objects. Data: `world.json` via `list_use_cases {include}` / `get_use_case`; writes `set_use_cases` (`entities`, `relationship_types`, `constellations`), `delete_entity` (the world kinds), `generate_personas {target: "constellations"}`. Empty pool: `usecases-world-empty`.

**Left panel:** compact sub-nav (`chrome-tab compact`, World active); a section list (Entities · Relationship types · Constellations, with counts and a warning count) that scrolls the main area; a one-line hint that the world works without a data model.

**Main:**
- **Entities** — native table: name with `uc-avatar entity`, type (free text), id (mono), traits (`uc-trait-chip`), data object (mono or "None"). Row → `usecases-entity-dialog`; "New entity" opens it empty.
- **Relationship types** — native table: label, **inverse label** (`inverse_label` as stored; "None" when not set — artisign never infers an inverse, §3.5), id, both ends share (`same_traits`, chips), data field (`object.field`). Row → `usecases-relationship-type-dialog`.
- **Constellations** — card grid: name, trait chips ("No traits" when none), "N relationships · members · used by N use cases". Generated ones (`generated: true`) are dashed with a "Generated" chip and, without relationships, say so. A card with a pool warning (target `constellation:<id>`, e.g. `self_relationship`) gets an amber border and the message. "Generate…" → `usecases-generate-dialog-constellations`, "New constellation" → `usecases-constellation-dialog`.

Pool warnings are shown on the entry they target (`entity:<id>`, `relationship_type:<id>`, `constellation:<id>`), never blocking.
